text: Header hint when the project needs a commit (not committed for days, or many uncommitted changes)
description: Felix 2026-10-16: show git status in the UI and prompt the human to commit, e.g. 'not committed for 3 days' or 'more than 10 uncommitted changes'. Clicking the hint opens the commit dialog (aacfc1ff). Counts .bowman and code changes; read-only projects show nothing.
